name: Learning through Teaching: Programming Courses at Schools
description: Participants in this course can choose from three different projects: Hacker School, ReDi, and TUM LearnLabs. Participants inspire school students with programming courses at a basic level. Through small programs and games, they give young people insights into digital topics, strengthen their IT skills, and share their passion for their chosen field of study. Participants work in teams and independently supervise young people in a school class. They improve their communication skills on IT topics with young people who have no IT experience, apply presentation techniques, practice moderation skills, and train their creativity in new situations. The course instructors prepare participants for their assignments with tried-and-tested, didactically sound concepts for programming courses in different languages and topics, such as Scratch, HTML, Python, Bash, and Swift.
prerequisites:
- Basic programming skills (IN0001 and IN0002 or equivalent). 
- Willingness to learn entry-level technologies (such as Scratch, HTML, Python, Bash, or Swift) 
- German language skills (at least B2)
